where: Cinderhead Deep (the three descent galleries to the old crew's vigil-lamp)
mood: The deep galleries where dense crystal turns the dark luminous — a sparkle-led descent, minor warming to its relative major.
core_styles: A minor warming to C major
bright glassy bell lead singing an ascending sparkling melody
glassy ascending bell arpeggios catching light
low synth bass drone that rises stepwise and warms
soft distant pick-tap percussion, bright chime shimmer
deep crystal cavern dungeon, hopeful discovery in the dark

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet atmospheric entrance into the deep: a low drone, a distant pick-tap, then a slow upward sparkle of crystal bells as your lamp catches the veins}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the bell melody climbs: a rising leap in A minor reaching upward step by step, glinting arpeggios rising beneath it, steady and searching}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a second bell answering a third above and the pad warming, the bass beginning to climb}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the gallery gleams — a lift into C major, the melody finally lands bright and high over a rising bass, luminous and hopeful, a crystal chamber full of light, then shadow returns}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the climbing bell melody returns in A minor; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
